main.description: Per-user eaten.at settings, stored in the user's own repo. All fields optional; absence means defaults.

defaultPublication.description: AT-URI of the account's eaten.at publication: the site.standard.publication eaten.at writes every document to and shows for a bare handle URL. Absent, or naming a record that no longer exists, means the account has none yet; one is created on the first publish.

crosspostToBluesky.description: Whether to default the Bluesky crosspost toggle on when publishing. Per-document override always available.
